observation.command: for p in / /ea-repository /eam-unterstuetzung /prinzipien-richtlinien /referenzarchitekturen /technologie-radar; do code=$(curl -s -o /tmp/page.html -w "%{http_code}" "http://localhost:3000$p"); title=$(grep -oP '(?<=<title>)[^<]+' /tmp/page.html | head -1); echo "$code  $p  title=$title"; done; code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://localhost:3000/nonexistent-page"); echo "$code  /nonexistent-page (expect 404)"
